mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, state, current_room_id AS currentRoomId, current_room_name AS currentRoomName, enter_log_id AS enterLogId, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM scan_occupancy_state WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scan_occupancy_state ( user_id, state, current_room_id, current_room_name, enter_log_id, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{state}, #{currentRoomId}, #{currentRoomName}, #{enterLogId}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = VALUES(state), current_room_id = VALUES(current_room_id), current_room_name = VALUES(current_room_name), enter_log_id = VALUES(enter_log_id), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
